import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares

 't*v':lambda q,t,x,v: q[3]*t*v,
 't*sqrtx':lambda q,t,x,v: q[3]*t*np.sqrt(x),
 't*sqrtv':lambda q,t,x,v: q[3]*t*np.sqrt(v),
 'cos(qt)*x':lambda q,t,x,v: q[3]*np.cos(q[4]*t)*x,
 'cos(qt)*v':lambda q,t,x,v: q[3]*np.cos(q[4]*t)*v,
 'sin(qt)*x':lambda q,t,x,v: q[3]*np.sin(q[4]*t)*x,
 'sin(qt)*v':lambda q,t,x,v: q[3]*np.sin(q[4]*t)*v,
 'sin(qt)':lambda q,t,x,v: q[3]*np.sin(q[4]*t),
 'cos(qt)':lambda q,t,x,v: q[3]*np.cos(q[4]*t),
 't^q':lambda q,t,x,v: q[3]*np.abs(t)**q[4],
 'exp(qt)':lambda q,t,x,v: q[3]*np.exp(q[4]*t),
 'exp(qt)*x':lambda q,t,x,v: q[3]*np.exp(q[4]*t)*x,
 'log(t)':lambda q,t,x,v: q[3]*np.log(np.abs(t)+q[4]),
 'sin(qt)*sqrtx':lambda q,t,x,v: q[3]*np.sin(q[4]*t)*np.sqrt(x),
 'cos(qt)*sqrtx':lambda q,t,x,v: q[3]*np.cos(q[4]*t)*np.sqrt(x),
 'cos(qt)*sqrtv':lambda q,t,x,v: q[3]*np.cos(q[4]*t)*np.sqrt(v),
 'sin(qt)*sqrtv':lambda q,t,x,v: q[3]*np.sin(q[4]*t)*np.sqrt(v),
 'x*v*t':lambda q,t,x,v: q[3]*t*x*v,
 'cos(qx)*t':lambda q,t,x,v: q[3]*np.cos(q[4]*x)*t,
 'sin(qx)*t':lambda q,t,x,v: q[3]*np.sin(q[4]*x)*t,
}
for name,f in cands.items():
    best=None
    np.random.seed(0)
    for s in range(25):

        try:
            rr=least_squares(g,p0)
            if best is None or rr.cost<best.cost: best=rr
        except Exception: pass
